publication issues.summary: This is a partial, unapproved review; the selected model, raw and TXT remain unchanged. The raw file is a deterministic restoration of the model, not an independent acquisition. Historical review and keys are not current electrical or source approval. This single-page attempt does not reopen DS105 or pair publication. The canonical model and explicit TXT converted with findings, exit 0, source writes 0. Its one unresolved difference is [157,61], source ┼ versus V4 ◇; no exact-point source junction or unjoined record was found. The flagged comparison against the original was inspected using the same registration, but local offset and faint scan leave the interpretation unresolved. The V4 digest matches its review sidecar; zero converter uncertainties does not clear inherited source holds. Full external schema was not run. The native scan shows BB's D02 followed by a hollow diamond, and BF's D09 followed by a distinct asterisk and diamond; short elbows to KB13 and KD13 are visible. The accepted BB.output-B13 and BF.output-D13 passive K observations, normal B13/D13, BB.output-D02 and BF.output-D09✲ driver records, and DS101.BB4 / RX111.BF4 targets remain intact. Visual shape alone does not establish their electrical roles or a physical pin from the asterisk. The parent viewed the native overview, 25 overlapping registered sections and panels for all 21 junction and 195 unjoined records; a read-only child sampled the native scan, six overlapping regions, and focused crops. The ledger maps 83 paths and 193 segments to sections. These local attempts do not certify each route end to end, omitted-wire completeness, or electrical continuity. The J80/AT-BJ area, the AV output area, and DS108 input row show red-blue displacement or route differences that remain unresolved; dense crossings and scan grain limit attribution. No join is inferred from a crossing. Block fit is 54/56 with median 2.05 pixels; independently seeded edge fit is 26/36 with median 1.16 pixels. Sampled fits differ up to 7.92 render pixels. Neither fit certifies local nonlinear scanwarp. Eleven repeated-coordinate segments and 17 unlabelled pin entries remain as data. See manifest and ledgers for bindings and commands. No canonical/shared/production/key/Git/publication changes were made. Native, source, electrical, full trace and omission remain bounded by source review. Current selected json differs from candidate source; historical mismatch retained. The candidate source does not fully match the previous local selection: model match False, text match True. The previous selection is preserved in the publication receipt.
